userFeedback: The finial correction passed, but the fish heads remained too spherical and nozzle-like and required a closer sculptural match.

reviews.notes: The copper collar is a true torus rather than the V8 solid disc.
Gameplay and three-quarter browser captures show the near arc while the opaque finial hides the far arc.
The direct top browser capture shows no copper ring through the finial.
Outward finial winding plus FrontSide depth-tested opaque materials fixes the Three.js-only see-through defect.
The corrected asset remains within all triangle, material, draw-call, collider, and mesh-health budgets.
